package.name: corvid
package.summary: PHP bindings for corvid, an embedded database with vector, full-text, graph, and geo search
package.description:
A native PHP extension (C) over corvid's published, checksummed FFI artifacts: Corvid\Db / Corvid\Collection / fluent Corvid\Query, the full value mapping (maps/arrays, Corvid\Bytes, Corvid\Vector), and Corvid\Exception carrying the engine's error-code table. The engine's golden fixture suite (267 executable lines) is replayed through this extension's public API on every CI run.
This is a source extension: building it links libcorvid, which is NOT bundled — fetch the pinned release artifacts first (fetch.sh / fetch.ps1 in the corvid-php repository) or install libcorvid somewhere standard and point --with-corvid at it.
package.notes: First release candidate: tracks engine v0.3.0 (FFI ABI version 1, 124 symbols). PHP 8.3+ NTS and ZTS. Golden-suite port, surface manifest, and the six-example tour live in the corvid-php repository and run in its CI.

configureoption.name: with-corvid
configureoption.prompt: path to the corvid FFI artifacts (corvid.h + libcorvid)
